Max 4 named pilots · Starting warchest 3000 SP

Track BV limit = 3000 × trackScale (Claybird FORCE TO&E / HSDR p.36). Contract BV = 4500 × contractScale when BSP on. Base BSP = 32 × trackScale; bonus from unused track BV ÷ 20 (cap 32 × scale). Sources: Claybird REFERENCE & CALC + hinterlands.txt.

NAMED PILOTS (0/4)

Name / Edge / SPADEPLOYGPEdge TokEdge AbsWoundsBankSP SpentHandicap

Only the initial two named pilots start with a 150 SP Bank + Edge Tok 1 (Draconis Reach p.34). Any later named hire (+ PILOT once two exist) costs 150 SP from the warchest (ledger: “Hire named pilot”), starts at Bank 0, and keeps the built-in Edge Tok 1. Unnamed hires cost 100 SP. Bank is editable (type a value; saved to Hot Spots). Improving G/P/Edge spends from Bank; Combat Pay pilot shares add to Bank (deployed pilots only, max 100/pilot/track — Reach p.34). Edge Tok: step on top, Price (Token SP) centered under it. Unnamed: track manually (Regular G4/P5 = 100 SP; Green free). Heal wound = 30 SP.

HOT SPOTS (Classic BT) — Contract & Ledger

ACTIVE CONTRACT TERMS

Contract Steps Table: Hot Spots: Draconis Reach p.28 (Claybird HSDR REFERENCE & CALC; e.g. Base Pay step 8 = 110%, Support step 7 = Straight/90%). Hinterlands pp.17–20 = older 13-step table. Maint. = 500 × Scale /mo; Transport = 300 × Scale; Base Pay = % of maint. Combat Pay: Success 500×Scale, Unsuccessful 250×Scale, All Objectives 750×Scale (highest only). Negotiation: Reputation → step ups (Reach caps per-term; Claybird Max Step Term Increase). Pilot award (Reach p.34 errata): up to 200×Scale total, max 100 SP per named pilot per track, split evenly (rounded down) among named pilots that took part (DEPLOY) incl. KIA, who are not paid; benched get nothing.

TRACK OUTCOME QUICK LOG

After Combat Pay (or other credits) land in the warchest, named pilots may be paid from that pool. Reach p.34 (errata): a pool of up to 200 × Scale is divided evenly among the named pilots that took part in the track (DEPLOY checked), max 100 SP per pilot; each share is rounded down and any remainder stays in the warchest (book example: 200 ÷ 3 pilots = 66 each). Pilots that took part but were killed (KIA) still count in the divisor but are not paid — their share stays in the warchest. Benched / non-participating pilots get nothing. All values stay editable (Max SP per pilot is saved on the force). Counts auto from Force TO&E DEPLOY; edit fields to override (fat-finger fix). APPLY credits by DEPLOY checkbox. Does not replace COMBAT PAY.

Override sticky until Sync or a DEPLOY toggle.

HOW THIS DIFFERS FROM HOT DROPS ACES

  • BV not PV — Classic BattleTech Battle Value, not Alpha Strike Point Value.
  • G/P skills — Classic Gunnery/Piloting, not AS Skill rating.
  • HSDR / Hinterlands SP tables — repair = tons×severity; pilot SP from Claybird REFERENCE; heal = 30 SP/wound.
  • Separate save key — bt_hotspots_v1 never shares SP/warchest/pilots with Aces bt_aces_v4_tactical.
  • Starting warchest — Hot Spots default 3000 SP; Aces companies start at 400 SP (book sortie-log example, p.37) and the Warchest is editable.
HOT SPOTS (Classic BT) — Table Log (phone-friendly)
UNDER CONSTRUCTION - ALPHAA construction site to play with. Entries are saved only on this device in their own key (bt_tablelog_v1). Hot Spots is changed only when you tap APPLY SELECTED on a review screen.
HOW THIS WORKS (ALPHA)

Idea: log each track on a phone at the table (big buttons, almost no typing), then move the log to the tablet by QR, text or file and review it there.

  1. Roster (tablet → phone): on the tablet open this page and tap SEND ROSTER PACK (QR). On the phone tap SCAN QR (CAMERA), point it at the code, then USE THIS ROSTER. (On the tablet itself the roster is read live from the Hot Spots force.)
  2. Log a track (phone): pick the track type, WIN/LOSS, tap deployed pilots, wounds, damaged units, rearm, salvage, notes — then SAVE ENTRY.
  3. Send (phone → tablet): SHOW QR; on the tablet SCAN QR (CAMERA). Long logs become several frames: keep scanning (any order) or press NEXT / AUTO-PLAY on the phone.
  4. Review (tablet): the incoming entries appear in REVIEW INCOMING LOG. Tick what you want, then APPLY SELECTED or DISCARD. Nothing changes before that.

No camera / camera blocked? (common when the page is opened from a file or from My Files) use COPY AS TEXT then PASTE TEXT on the other device, or DOWNLOAD .JSON then UPLOAD .JSON FILE, or SCAN A PHOTO of the QR. These all work offline.

What APPLY does: adds one line per entry to the Hot Spots Campaign Log; adds logged wounds to a pilot whose name matches exactly one pilot in the active force; sets a matching unit's repair state to Armor damage only (light) or Structure damage (heavy), never downgrading and never applying destroyed. Nothing else (no SP, ledger, reputation or tracks). Each entry id is applied once.

Limits: one QR frame carries about 120–320 characters of data (frame size SMALL / NORMAL / DENSE in the transfer card); a typical entry is 2–4 frames. More than 120 frames is refused — use text or a file.

Dictation: tap the microphone on your phone keyboard while the Notes box is focused. A browser DICTATE button appears only if this browser offers speech recognition.

DEMO / SAMPLE DATA creates a sample roster pack and a sample entry so you can try the whole QR loop with two devices (or show the QR on one and scan with the other).

BATTLEFIELD SUPPORT (BSP) — Strikes & Assets · Decks for deployment · BSP only (no BV / PV conversion here)
HOT SPOTS — Contract & Mission Builder (MVP)

Random offers: Campaign Operations pp.39–42 (ROLL, or enter your own 2D6). Terms: Reach p.28. Scale: Reach p.36. Tracks: Reach pp.167–175; branching pattern Reach p.76. Drafts are saved separately; only SEND TO ACTIVE CONTRACT TERMS writes to your Hot Spots contract.

HOT SPOTS — Campaign Map (hex-map worlds)

First Official world: Mallory’s World / Loneliness Island, Hot Spots: Draconis Reach pp.134–142. Map art is our own drawing (no book artwork). Dice: enter your roll or tap ROLL. Income is shown for you to post in your Hot Spots ledger; the map never writes your other saves.

FORCE BATTLE LOG — one log per force (Aces, Hot Spots, Missions, Campaign Map)

Custom record-keeping tool (not a rulebook procedure). Entries are added automatically when a Hot Spots track is appended, a Missions result is published, a Campaign Map battle is resolved or an Aces sortie is settled; Hot Spots salvage / ransom ledger lines are copied into that force's newest entry. Nothing here changes Warchests, ledgers or rosters.

CHARGE / DEATH FROM ABOVE CALCULATOR (BattleTech Core Rulebook pp.77–80)

Base TN = attacker Piloting + comparative modifier (attacker Piloting − target Piloting, p.77) + attacker movement + target TMM + terrain (charge only). Charge p.78, DFA pp.79–80.

MISSIONS — pick-up games (Classic: Core pp.212–233 · Alpha Strike: ASCE pp.126–134)

Official rules only. Missions keep their own save and never read or change your Aces, Hot Spots or Builder data. Core Scale (2,000 BV per step, Core p.219) is not Hot Spots Scale.

IMPORT / EXPORT — save backups & restore (JSON files, plus the BSP photo .zip)
Exporting never changes your data. Importing replaces the matching save on this device (you are asked to confirm first), so export a backup before you import. Files download to your browser's download folder.
